summary: Two outlined neutral Buttons (Next lead, Snooze) with a Kbd keyboard hint in the trailing slot, marked trailingHint so the hint disappears below md and on touch screens without leaving a gap.
use: Queue and inbox actions that show a keyboard shortcut on desktop only.
spec: `<Button variant="outlined" tone="neutral" trailingHint>` labelled Next lead with a `trailing` snippet holding `<Kbd>K</Kbd>`
A second one labelled Snooze with `<Kbd>S</Kbd>`
